description: A library of functions to generate JUnit XML reports for test scripts, supporting integration with Git and Azure Pipelines.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes JUnit XML output, creates directory and file, and starts the test suite.

methods.name: start_test_case_output
methods.description: Records the start time of a test case.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes a test case, recording its result and output in JUnit XML format.

methods.name: finalize_test_output
methods.description: Completes the test suite XML, adjusting overall timing and closing tags.

methods.name: write_junit_xml
methods.description: Writes XML content to the JUnit report file, with optional truncation.

methods.name: xml_attr_encode
methods.description: Encodes strings for XML attributes, optionally without line feeds.
